component.name: OpenGG
component.summary: Unofficial SteelSeries GG alternative for the Apex 3 TKL and Rival 3 Wireless Gen 2

description.p: OpenGG is a community made, unofficial desktop application that brings the SteelSeries GG experience to Linux. It talks to the devices directly over HID.

ul.li: SteelSeries Apex 3 TKL - 8 zone illumination, effects, brightness
SteelSeries Rival 3 Wireless Gen 2 - CPI presets, polling rate, button mapping, battery level

description.p: Not affiliated with or endorsed by SteelSeries.
